subject: Application: Civil Designer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am preparing an application for the Civil Designer role at the City of Busselton (SEEK job 94960289), closing 4.30pm on 19 October 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for regional work and open to discussing relocation. The role's roads, drainage and civil infrastructure design work matches my Advanced Diploma focus. I have not used Microstation or 12D; my CAD tools are AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and I am willing to learn Council's preferred packages.

I have attached my resume and cover letter for the online application.

Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Designer vacancy at the City of Busselton advertised on SEEK (job 94960289), with applications invited until 4.30pm on Monday 19 October 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering completed in the Philippines in 2019.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked as field engineer and project-in-charge on construction sites in the Philippines, covering inspections, progress monitoring, crew coordination and site records. That experience sits beside my design documentation training.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to the Busselton region. I am willing to undergo a National Police Clearance and other pre-employment checks.

The role asks for a tertiary civil qualification or civil design experience and strong CAD skills, with Microstation and 12D preferred. I meet the qualification path and use AutoCAD and Civil 3D from my Advanced Diploma. I have not used Microstation or 12D yet and would learn those tools on the job. I have attached my resume and this letter for the online application.
